hardware: Intel Core i7-12700H, 16 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 3060 Laptop 6 GB (held near 250 MHz by power and thermal limits)

proposals.statement: Dispatch happens on WhatsApp with drivers replying to messages and a shared spreadsheet used at night to track collections

evidence.quote: We run forty trucks between Gauteng and the Western Cape, out of two depots, Midrand and Bloemfontein. Dispatch happens on WhatsApp. The controller posts the collections in a group, the drivers reply, and then somebody types it all into a shared spreadsheet at night. We miss collections because messages get buried.

proposals.statement: The app must ensure every collection is assigned and confirmed

evidence.quote: So the app has to make sure every collection is assigned and confirmed.

proposals.statement: The app must track collections to prevent missed deliveries

evidence.quote: We miss collections because messages get buried.

proposals.statement: The app must handle collections for forty trucks operating between Gauteng and the Western Cape

evidence.quote: We run forty trucks between Gauteng and the Western Cape, out of two depots, Midrand and Bloemfontein.

proposals.statement: The app must handle collections for two depots: Midrand and Bloemfontein

evidence.quote: out of two depots, Midrand and Bloemfontein.

proposals.statement: The app must track collections for approximately one hundred and twenty per day

evidence.quote: About a hundred and twenty a day.

proposals.statement: The app must handle collections for up to two hundred and sixty per day during December

evidence.quote: On the bad days in December we've had two hundred and sixty.

proposals.statement: The app must prevent re-delivery costs of eighteen hundred rand per missed collection

evidence.quote: A re-delivery is about eighteen hundred rand

proposals.statement: The app must prevent loss of client trust due to missed collections

evidence.quote: we lose the client's trust, which is worse.

proposals.statement: The app must prevent loss of retail accounts due to missed collections

evidence.quote: Last December we lost one retail account over it.

proposals.statement: Drivers need to accept jobs, mark collections, take photos of waybills, and get signatures while working offline due to poor signal between Colesberg and Beaufort West

evidence.quote: Accept the job, mark it collected, take a photo of the waybill, and get a signature. But you must understand, between Colesberg and Beaufort West there's no signal for hours. It has to work offline and send everything when they're back in range.

proposals.statement: The client uses a truck tracking system from a vendor and Sage for invoicing

evidence.quote: Our trucks have a tracking system from a vendor, so we can see where they are. And invoicing runs on Sage.

proposals.statement: The client's management must approve any budget over two hundred thousand rand, with a requirement to present a figure by the end of January

evidence.quote: Our MD signs off anything above two hundred thousand rand. I'd want to show her a figure by the end of January.

proposals.statement: The client has a network and depot computers managed by one person who is currently late to the meeting

evidence.quote: Sorry I'm late, I was stuck in another call. I look after their network and the depot computers.
